ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (72) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 2, 14, 64, 67, 70, 71 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Поврежденный» (povrezhdenny, 'damaged') is 'the damaged one' in the title and in the narrator's own use, and the physician's «повредилась» (povredilas', 'got damaged') of the 'machine' keeps the same root; «лекарь» (lekar', 'physician', the lower medical degree) and «доктор» (doktor, 'doctor') are kept distinct as Herzen varies them, and the pun «за границей» / «в границах» (za granitsey / v granitsakh, 'beyond the border' / 'within the border') is kept literal. The Latin, French, and German phrases stay in the body with the Russian footnote glosses translated; six blocks with no website draft (the opening paragraph, the physician's reply with the Latin tag, his 'orangutans' remark, Yevgeny Nikolaevich's long last speech, and the notes) were translated fresh.
Source observation: [2] «восчики» (voschiki) is evidently a slip for «возчики» (vozchiki, 'carters'); translated 'carters'.
Source observation: [17] «т. e.» is printed with a Latin 'e' in the abbreviation «т. е.» (t. e., 'that is'); no effect on the sense.
Source observation: [65] «Ост-Индской кампании» (kampanii, 'campaign') is evidently «компании» (kompanii, 'company'); translated 'the East India Company'.
